results.title: Karnataka Final Voter List Down By Nearly 1 Crore After Special Revision
results.description:
Karnataka has 4.55 crore voters in the final electoral rolls published on Tuesday following the SIR process, the CEO office said.

The state had 5,54,32,314 voters before the SIR process. The number has now fallen to 4,55,00,011, a reduction of 99.32 lakh voters.

According to the CEO's office, the final rolls comprise 2,25,40,493 male voters, 2,29,12,355 female voters and 2,841 third-gender voters.

results.title: Ladakh Enduro Park Highest-Altitude Motorcycle Training Arena in Asia
results.description:
Ladakh has long been a dream destination for motorcyclists. But what happens when you combine the region's legendary terrain with a purpose-built off-road riding facility?

In this episode of NDTV AutoMate Culture, Siddhartha Sharma visits the CEAT Ladakh Enduro Park, located at nearly 3,500 metres above sea level in Leh.

Recognised by the India Book of Records and the Asia Book of Records as Asia's Highest-Altitude Motorcycle Training Arena, the facility has trained more than 2,500 riders since opening in 2024.

From technical off-road obstacles and rider training programmes to motorcycle rentals, rider safety initiatives and community development, we explore what makes this destination special for adventure riders from across India and around the world.

Featuring an exclusive conversation with Amit of Throttle Shrottle, we discover how this unique facility is helping build a stronger culture of off-road motorcycling in India.
